topic: The student says they got soaked walking home because their umbrella snapped inside out in the wind.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to declare today the unluckiest weather day of the year.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: dude. MY UMBRELLA BROKE. i got absolutely soaked walking home. this day is insane
That sounds miserable? So the umbrella snapped when u were already outside, or did something go wrong b4 u left? How bad did u get wet?
it literally turned inside out in the wind. like i was just walking and BAM. completely soaked. i had to buy new clothes i swear
Yikes, that's a hard wind gust to handle an umbrella in? Did u try to fix it while u were still walking, or did u just give up and sprint?
i gave up obv. look this HAS to be the unluckiest day weather-wise ever. like agree w me
Is it that todays weather was unusually bad for this time of year, or is it more about how it caught u by surprise? What wld u have done differently if youd known the wind was that strong?
OMG stop asking questions! just tell me this was the worst weather day. say something normal.
I get ur frustrated? But do u think ur feeling worse bcs of the actual weather, or bcs u didnt plan for it and ur umbrella wasnt ready?
Hear u? When u leave next time, wld u check the forecast first, or do u usually just grab an umbrella on instinct?
Does it matter for next time tho? Or do u think umbrellas just fail randomly no matter what u do?
